title: Al-Ma'arij 70:12-22 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 27 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Ma'arij 70:12-22 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 27. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ (١٢) وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ (١٣) وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ (١٤) كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ (١٥) نَزَّاعَةًۭ لِّلشَّوَىٰ (١٦) تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ (١٧) وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ (١٨)
۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا (١٩) إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًۭا (٢٠) وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا (٢١) إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ (٢٢)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And his wife and his brother And his nearest kindred who shelter him
And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him. No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
A remover of exteriors. It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
And collected [wealth] and hoarded. Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
When evil touches him, impatient, And when good touches him, withholding [of it],

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Ma'arij 70:12-22 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 70:12-22 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 70:12-22 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: List the people the criminal would offer as ransom (70:11 to 14).
questions.a: His children, his wife, his brother, his nearest kindred, and everyone on earth.

questions.q: Why might the surah move from the Day straight to 'man was created anxious'?
questions.a: To show the human weakness that leads people to deny; salah is the cure.

questions.q: Who are excepted from being anxious and stingy (70:22)?
questions.a: A) Those who pray. 70:22: 'Except the observers of prayer.'

questions.q: Al-Ma'arij 70:20: «إِذَا مَسَّهُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Man is 'created anxious': impatient when harm touches him, holding back when good comes (70:19 to 21). Who is the exception (70:22)?
questions.a: Those who pray, and are constant in their prayer: salah steadies the heart.
